cases.text: Write a compact C function that returns the larger of two signed integers, followed by three simple assertions. Output code only.
Explain the likely defect in a ring buffer whose write index is incremented without applying the capacity, then provide a corrected C function. Be concise.
Produce a numbered list of eight short rules for reproducible storage benchmarks. Each item must contain one action and one reason.
A cache holds 100 equal-size objects. A workload references 160 objects with a stable hot set of 60. Explain why hit rate alone does not determine latency and identify two additional measurements.
